candidate.answerReason: After the two row reversals, the diagonals contain 1, 10, 17, 22 and 4, 9, 16, 25. Their sums are 50 and 54, with positive difference 4.

methods.label: Track the diagonal entries
methods.explanation:
First track how reversing the rows changes the entries in each diagonal. The second row becomes \(11,10,9,8\), and the fourth row becomes \(25,24,23,22\). The first and third rows stay as displayed.

The diagonal from upper left to lower right now has sum
\[
1+10+17+22=50.
\]
The diagonal from upper right to lower left has sum
\[
4+9+16+25=54.
\]
The positive difference is therefore \(54-50=\boxed{4}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
methods.levelReason: Tracking row positions and adding or subtracting small whole numbers requires only elementary arithmetic.
